headline: Anthropic filing says Claude may soon hit its self-acceleration threshold
body: Anthropic's amended IPO filing said Claude may 'imminently' reach the Responsible Scaling Policy threshold for AI-driven acceleration of AI research, and disclosed about $895 billion in compute commitments. That pushed both Capability Velocity and Power Concentration up. Marvell's roughly $115 billion all-stock deal for Lumentum added more to Power Concentration, which rose 0.49 on the day, the largest factor move. Abu Dhabi signed four deals with OpenAI, including machine-readable government rules, lifting AI Autonomy. Meituan's 1.6-trillion-parameter LongCat-2.5, trained on Chinese chips, and Germany's 'KI-Nation 2030' plan added to Capability Velocity, while SUSE's 10% job cuts, citing AI, nudged Shared Prosperity down. Zookeeper, Enslaved God and Benevolent Dictator rose. Horizon Balance fell to -17.93 from -17.72.
movers_note: Zookeeper +0.41, led by the Abu Dhabi-OpenAI deals (+0.14) and the Marvell-Lumentum deal (+0.12). Enslaved God +0.35, led by Marvell-Lumentum (+0.18) and Anthropic's filing (+0.12). Benevolent Dictator +0.33, from Marvell-Lumentum (+0.15) and the Abu Dhabi deals (+0.15).
